newsitem.title: USA: ITT in joint venture with Davis Gaming LLC.
newsitem.headline: ITT in joint venture with Davis Gaming LLC.

text.p: ITT Corp said Sunday it agreed to form a joint venture with Davis Gaming LLC that will split the ownership of a Las Vegas casino and study the possible construction of another hotel and casino.

ITT will receive $250 million in cash for the 50 percent stake in The Desert Inn Resort and Casino. The funds will consist of $150 million from Davis Gaming and another $100 million in proceeds from a future debt offering by the joint venure, the company said in a news release.
The deal, it said, is expected to immediately add ITT's earnings.

ITT bought The Desert Inn in 1993 for $160 million. It will continue to manage the hotel through its Caeser's World subsidiary for an initial 10-year period, with an option for another 10-year period, the company said.

The venture will take the next two years to study the possibility of building another hotel and casino on a 34-acre parcel of land adjacent to The Desert Inn. If a new facility in built, it will also be managed by ITT.
The transaction will include "change of control" provisions for Davis Gaming similar to those struck by other parties since the launch of Hilton Hotels Corp's hostile takeover bid for ITT Corp.
The deal is contingent on the execution of a definitive agreement and due diligence, and is expected to be completed by Nov. 1, ITT said.
